description.narrative: The partner will support building the capacity of the private sector to link community based ecotourism sites to the market. The Cambodia Sustainable Landscape and Ecotourism Project (CSLEP) is a six-year initiative (2019–2025) funded by the World Bank and the Global Environment Facility, with a total investment of approximately $55 million. Implemented by Cambodia’s Ministry of Environment and Ministry of Rural Development, the project focuses on the Cardamom Mountains–Tonle Sap (CMTS) landscape, which spans over 3.8 million hectares across seven provinces. TTG AsiaAsian Economic Community+10Tourism Cambodia10TTG Asia+10CSLEP aims to enhance the management of protected areas, promote ecotourism, and develop non-timber forest product value chains. Key activities include constructing 500 km of hiking trails, establishing visitor centers, and improving infrastructure to support ecotourism corridors linking Siem Reap and Phnom Penh with the Cardamom Mountains and Tonle Sap Lake.

participating-org.narrative:
Impact Hub Phnom Penh (IHPP) registered as a social enterprize company that has been supporting Cambodian entrepreneurs for over 5 years and is considered to be one of the largest active communities of young entrepreneurs in Cambodia, particularly those who are creating a positive impact.
Vision: A more sustainable and innovative Cambodia Mission: Empowering youth and startups in Cambodia tocontribute to solving problems (social and environmental) through entrepreneurship and leadership. Impact Goals: - Inspire: To unlock the potential of youth by inspiring them to grow, find their passions, and become change makers - Connect: Build a flourishing and well-connected community of impact-driven change makers and entrepreneurs - Enable: More successful social enterprises emerge in Cambodia
Impact Hub Phnom Penh (IHPP) is an impact-first venture incubator targeting Cambodian young entrepreneurs. Their vision is to build a more innovative and impactful Cambodia through entrepreneurial mindsets and skills building. They achieve this through inspiring, enabling and connecting young entrepreneurs through the models of entrepreneurship and innovation, aligning ourselves with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
Their focus over the past 6 yearshas been the development of locally rooted and holistic support to enable the development of entrepreneurial mindsets, confidence to innovate and technical business skills through regular and high quality events, training, tailored coaching and communitynetworking. Since 2015, they have incubated and engaged with 600 young entrepreneurs across 30+ programs; inspired over 9,000 youth through events; built a strong and diverse local and internationalnetwork that supports impact ventures including a pool of30+ professional and personal coaches; and launched a high-quality, interactive online learning platform in Khmer language in 2018 featuring top inspiring role models and entrepreneurs from across the country, to teach 21st century skills to young aspiring entrepreneurs and leaders.
Impact Hub Phnom Penh has the institutional capacity and track record to understand the issues and implement solutions regarding innovation and entrepreneurship in Cambodia.
